تنتهكين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِكِينَ (tantahikīna) /tan.ta.hi.kiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# تُنْتَهَكِينَ (tuntahakīna) /tun.ta.ha.kiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
